title: Add admin-only persistent editable text labels under TSIC Logger ID buttons

requirements.text: Add a backend storage map that persists a text label (string) for each TSIC Logger ID button. Provide an admin-only update function to set the label for a given ID, and an admin-only query function to retrieve all labels. Non-admin callers must receive no label data whatsoever — the query must check admin status server-side and return an empty or rejected response for non-admins.

quotes: persistent blijven na het herladen van de pagina
de data wordt niet naar de client gestuurd als je geen admin bent

acceptanceCriteria: A stable map (survives upgrades) stores one text label per TSIC Logger ID key.
Only callers whose principal is the hardcoded admin principal (matching existing isCallerAdmin logic) can call the set-label function.
Only admin callers can call the get-labels query; non-admin callers receive an empty result or an error — no label data is returned.
Labels persist across canister upgrades and page reloads.

requirements.text: On the TSIC Loggers page, under each ID button, display an editable text input field that is only rendered when the current user is confirmed as an admin (via the existing useIsCallerAdmin hook). The field shows the saved label for that ID and allows the admin to edit and save it. Non-admin users see no input, no text, and no placeholder — the component must not render the label data into the DOM at all for non-admins.

quotes: bewerkbaar typveld dat iedereen met admin status deze tekst kan aanpassen
tekst mag maar zichtbaar zijn voor admins
voor andere gebruikers mag deze tekst nergens te vinden zijn. Ook niet in chrome inspecteren of console

acceptanceCriteria: Each ID button on the TSIC Loggers page has an editable text field rendered below it, visible only when useIsCallerAdmin returns true.
For non-admin users, neither the text field nor any label text appears in the rendered DOM.
Admin users can type in the field and save the label; the saved value persists after a page reload.
The frontend only fetches label data after confirming admin status; the fetch is not initiated for non-admin sessions.
Label data is never present in the JS bundle state or React component tree for non-admin users.

requirements.text: Add a React Query hook (e.g. useTSICLabels) that fetches all TSIC ID labels from the new backend query function, and a mutation hook to save a label for a given ID. Both must only be called when the user is an admin.

quotes: persistent blijven na het herladen van de pagina

acceptanceCriteria: useTSICLabels hook fetches labels only when isAdmin is true.
A mutation function allows saving a label by ID and invalidates the labels query on success.
Hooks follow the same pattern as existing hooks (useGoogleSheetsDownloadLink, useIsCallerAdmin).

constraints: Label data must never be returned by the backend to non-admin principals — enforce this with a server-side admin check, not just a frontend guard.
All Motoko logic must remain in backend/main.mo (single-actor architecture).
Do not modify any files listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
Use stable storage (e.g. stable var or stable HashMap) so labels survive canister upgrades.
nonGoals: Displaying labels to non-admin users in any form.
Adding labels to any page other than the TSIC Loggers page.
Allowing non-admin users to edit or view labels.
Any changes to the existing ID button appearance or navigation behavior.
